versions.content: Service Name FiM_DemTriggerOnMonitorStatus Syntax void FiM_DemTriggerOnMonitorStatus ( Dem_EventIdType EventId ) Service ID [hex] 0x02 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) EventId Identification of an Event by assigned event number. The Event Number is configured in the DEM. Min.: 1 (0: Indication of no Event or Failure) Max.: Result of configuration of Event Numbers in DEM (Max is either 255 or 65535) Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This service is provided to be called by the Dem in order to inform the Fim about monitor status changes. Available via FiM_Dem.h
